europe_now.title: Pope Leo XIV's State Visit to France
europe_now.summary: Pope Leo XIV has arrived in France for a state visit, delivering addresses at the Élysée Palace, UNESCO, and visiting Notre-Dame while calling for urgent dialogue and warning against losing humanity to artificial intelligence.

europe_now.summary: The European Union has vowed to pursue a 120 million euro fine on X despite US backing for Elon Musk's court challenge, while separate reports highlight ongoing challenges with Russian sanctions evasion via shadow fleet tankers.

top_stories.title: Papal Visit to France
top_stories.summary: Pope Leo XIV has commenced a state visit to France marked by high-profile addresses at UNESCO and the Élysée Palace. During his engagements in Paris, he urged public dialogue and warned about the societal impacts of artificial intelligence.

top_stories.title: EU Regulatory Enforcement and Sanctions
top_stories.summary: The European Union maintains its stance on pursuing a substantial fine against X following legal pushback and US backing. Meanwhile, analysts and member states continue to confront regulatory blind spots and enforcement hurdles regarding Russian shadow fleet tankers and supply chains.
